description: This source file defines the RecentTopicsProvider class, which manages a recent topics list for a Flutter application. It uses SharedPreferences for persistent storage, implements MRU (most recently used) list behavior, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: RecentTopicsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that maintains a list of recently opened topics, backed by SharedPreferences, with logic for adding/removing items, persistence, and change notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by loading saved recent topics from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: opened
methods.description: Marks a topic as opened; updates the MRU list and persists the change.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Handles asynchronously saving the current MRU list to SharedPreferences.
